steps.name: an uploaded asset is stored once in R2 and comes back
a page pushed by one client reaches the other client in the room
a client that joins while the room is live gets the page in its hydration
a connected client keeps the room alive through an idle period, and its next push commits
when everyone leaves the room saves to R2 and sleeps, and the page comes back from R2
a page pushed before an orange dev and engine restart is there after it

changes.what: Adds a top-level BEMO_BUCKET r2_buckets entry to apps/bemo-worker/wrangler.toml
changes.why: The project declares the bucket only under [env.*], and its dev script selects `--env dev`. `orange dev` runs the top-level config.
